items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: We played for T-Bone Walker, played for Joe Turner, and also played for Slim, all on the same stage.

ctx.x: Well, it's also probably cheaper in that you had one band and three artists in those days. You always, which...
That's what happened. So that's what happened. We played for T-Bone Walker, played for Joe Turner, and also played for Slim, all on the same stage.
Was that a lot of pressure, to have to learn three new material?
